headers: Estimates are minimums, but not guaranteed minimums, and the contract cost can increase so long as the unit costs remain the same and the increased funds are appropriated in the budget. Line item entries shall prevail over sum total entries.  When discrepancies exist between unit prices and corresponding extended prices, unit prices shall prevail.
sample: Prices must be submitted on the prescribed form and all blank spaces on the form for prices must be filled in, (in ink or typewritten for paper submittals). Failure to fill in all blank spaces shall cause the bid to be deemed non responsive and it will not be considered in determining the lowest responsible bidder

As part of the requirement to establish the responsibility of the Bidder, the City of El Paso may perform a price analysis to determine the reasonableness of the price(s) at which the supplies and/or services are Bid. Prices that are significantly lower than the mean of all bids and that appear to be unreasonably low may be determined to be evidence of non-responsibility, and cause the Bid to be rejected and not considered in determining the lowest responsible bidder.

headers:
423 Rock Retaining Wall should the unit of
measure for this item be? If not, can you
provide the correct quantity for the SF
measurement?

Quantities for Retaining wall will be revised to reflect a SF unit
of measurement since they are currently reflecting linear
footage. Plan sheets pertaining to this will be provided with
revision reflecting the new quantities for this bid item provided
with revisions in forthcoming amendment A002
Per bid item 423 under the payment section, footings shall be
fully compensated by the contractor’s price, however we will
add a note calling out the foot to be subsidiary to item 423.
sample:
450 Handrail Ty E is the handrail to be
mounted on the sidewalk or will it be
mounted adjacent to the sidewalk on its
own independent concrete footing?

The Standard detail PRD-13 (MOD) (Sheet C52) specifies how
the rail shall be mounted, it will be pinned mounted on the
sidewalk. Contractor shall bid construction documents per
plan.

Sheet 74 shows 18" Gabion Mattresses
but there is not a bid item for gabion
mattresses. Can you provide a bid item for
the 18" Gabion Mattresses?

The design intent is to have gabions paid by CY sheet C74 is
calling out a gabion mattress, it will be revised to read gabion
only. Plan Sheets to be provided with revision forthcoming in
amendment A002, removing the Gabion Mattresses verbiage
as an addendum to the documents.
